title: Staged Binary-Local Diffusion Attention: Effective Few-Step Diffusion Along the Time Axis
description: Research software, English manuscript, datasets, and recorded experiments for staged binary-local diffusion attention. Includes exact sparse attention and Triton kernels, topology scans, matched dense/SBDA training and forward benchmarks, and the original JSON, CSV, and 28 experiment logs. Contact: haoyang@haoyangma.com. Included datasets retain their upstream terms. Includes paired PG-19 and Python accuracy results and a matched twenty-layer million-position forward benchmark.
